module: Recorder of the vehicle's trajectory during a rally recce. Every 2 m traveled, it captures position, orientation and steering, buffers the captures and appends them to the `driveline.json` file (one JSON line per capture) in the mission's recce folder. The module returns a constructor: `require(...)(vehicle, missionDir)`.
notes: The steering is read via core_vehicleBridge (key 'steering', registered as a change notification); it is nil as long as no value is cached.
The first capture only serves as an anchor (last_dist_pos): nothing is buffered until more than interval_m has been traveled.
The buffer is only written from 10 captures, unless writeCaptures(true) is called.

C.desc: Recorder bound to a vehicle. Fields: vehicle, interval_m (2), last_dist_pos, capturesBuffer, fname.

init.desc: Constructor. Registers the 'steering' change notification with core_vehicleBridge and computes the path of the driveline.json file via rallyUtil.missionReccePath.

truncateCapturesFile.desc: Empties the captures file (opened in "w" mode). Logs an error if opening fails.

writeCaptures.desc: Appends the buffer's captures to the file (one JSON line each) then empties the buffer. Without force, does nothing as long as the buffer contains fewer than 10 elements.

force.desc: true to write even with fewer than 10 captures.

capture.desc: To be called every frame: reads the vehicle's position and orientation (quatf from direction and up vector) and, if it has moved more than interval_m away from the last capture, buffers {ts, pos, quat, steering}. Then tries to write the buffer.

drawDebug.desc: Draws a semi-transparent blue sphere of radius 2 at the last captured position (debugDrawer:drawSphere).
